mcqs.question: What does the review say about smoking and the cause of pulmonary LCH?

options.A: Patients are smokers, but how smoking induces the disease is not known
options.C: The mechanism is fully known and is infection

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Patients are smokers, but how smoking induces the disease is not known
mcqs.explanation: Patients are smokers, and the mechanisms by which smoking induces the disease are not known.

sourceRefs.excerpt: mechanisms by which smoking induces this disease are not known

mcqs.question: Where does the review place the early inflammatory lesion?

options.A: Bronchiolar inflammation, with variable interstitial and vascular involvement
options.C: Only the pulmonary veins as in PVOD
options.E: The review describes only normal histology

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Bronchiolar inflammation, with variable interstitial and vascular involvement
mcqs.explanation: Bronchiolar inflammation may be accompanied by interstitial and vascular involvement. Advanced disease has cystic destruction.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Bronchiolar inflammation may be accompanied by variable lung interstitial and vascular involvement.

mcqs.question: What characterises more advanced pulmonary LCH in this review?
mcqs.explanation: More advanced stages are characterised by cystic lung destruction.

sourceRefs.excerpt: more advanced stages are characterized by cystic lung destruction

mcqs.question: What imaging does the review say should be obtained in every patient?

options.D: Skull X-ray as the only study
options.E: PET as the first and only test

mcqs.explanation: HRCT should be obtained in every patient and can distinguish PLCH from other cystic lung diseases.

sourceRefs.excerpt: High resolution chest CT (HRCT) should be obtained in every patient

mcqs.question: What does the review say influences management?

options.A: Whether disease is isolated to the lung or multisystem
options.B: Age alone, with one regimen for everyone
options.C: The review says management is identical in all patients
options.D: Only the smoking pack-year number, with no staging

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Whether disease is isolated to the lung or multisystem
mcqs.explanation: Management is highly influenced by isolated pulmonary versus multisystem disease.

sourceRefs.excerpt: highly influenced by disease extent (isolated pulmonary vs multi-systemic disease)
